title: The Trough
scene: What remains when the anger fades
together: The confrontation gives way to more vulnerable honesty. Neither the exhibition nor the relationship can be repaired by a perfect sentence.
For the first time that day, they begin to distinguish the intention behind an action from the way it feels to receive it.
aarna: She begins to recognize that his limitations do not necessarily mean an absence of love.
Understanding him does not erase her need for emotional presence; it gives them a clearer place from which to speak.
mukund: He begins to understand that her feelings are not another problem he can solve on her behalf.
Being with her in the pain may matter before any plan for what comes next.
